name: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking
old_description: Whitehurst Custom Woodworking specializes in handcrafted, heirloom quality furniture. Timeless designs, focus on function and an emphasis on natural materials and proper joinery techniques are used to craft each piece. Love your space with irresistible furniture that works for your lifestyle.
about:
Whitehurst Custom Woodworking is based in Raleigh, North Carolina. The business grew from the founder's lifelong interest in making things, nurtured by a metalworking father in Tarboro. After a decade spent in other careers, the founder turned a woodworking hobby into a full-time venture, though the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop produces handcrafted, heirloom-quality furniture and end-grain butcher blocks using traditional joinery techniques and solid wood. Every piece is built to order with an emphasis on natural materials and functional, timeless design. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves homeowners and designers throughout the Raleigh–Durham–Chapel Hill triangle, delivering custom pieces such as dining tables, sewing stations, and other built‑in furniture tailored to individual spaces.

Its stated mission is to preserve the craft of fine furniture making by offering the community furniture built with exceptional craftsmanship that is rooted in tradition and embraces innovation. The founder emphasizes that "how it's made matters" as a guiding principle.

name: Wicker Brothers Inc
old_description: At Wicker Brothers Custom Fabrication, we pride ourselves on being a fully equipped fabrication shop, ready to handle a wide range of projects, big or small. From design and prototyping to final installation, our team is committed to delivering high-quality results every step of the way.
about:
Wicker Brothers Inc operates a custom metal fabrication shop in Florence, Mississippi. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are its founders named in available sources.

The shop provides design and prototyping, welding and repairs, field repairs and installation, and manufacturing of custom metal parts. Its equipment lineup includes three hydraulic press brakes (175-ton, 200-ton, 75-ton), two hydraulic shears (10-foot and 12-foot), multiple hydraulic ironworkers, two horizontal bandsaws, plate rolls, a pipe bender, angle and tube rolling equipment, a spot welder, TIG, MIG, and laser welding machines, belt sanders, a Timesaver wide belt sander, an Amada 3 kW fiber laser, a Messer high-definition plasma cutter, a Calypso waterjet, a CNC horizontal bandsaw, a 10' x 10' x 25' powder coating oven, industrial sandblasting pots, three lathes, and three mills. The company also operates 15 fully equipped service trucks for on-site work. It states it can produce anything from a single custom part to thousands of components.

Wicker Brothers serves customers in the medical and hospital sector, restaurants, and shipping companies, according to its website.

The company emphasizes its ability to keep every production step in-house, which it says gives it strict control over due dates and delivery schedules. It also highlights a certified drafting and design team that consults on projects from concept to completion.

name: Wilderness Trace Solar
old_description: Located in Danville, KY. Wilderness Trace Solar specializes in solar panel installation and solar panel maintenance. 5-Year workmanship warranty. Free estimates. Transparency and trustworthiness. Call today and request a quote.
about:
Wilderness Trace Solar is based in Danville, Kentucky, and was established in 2015. The privately held company serves Central and Eastern Kentucky with solar energy solutions.

The firm designs, installs, and maintains photovoltaic systems for residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural, and municipal customers. It provides turn‑key installation, from site assessment and system engineering through permitting and commissioning. In addition to installation services, the company operates a warehouse stocking solar panels, inverters, racking, and mounting hardware from brands such as Emmvee, SolarEdge, SMA Solar Technology, APsystems, SnapNrack, Powers Solar Frames, and SIGMATEK, offering pickup and delivery for do‑it‑yourself projects.

Customers include homeowners seeking to lower electricity bills, farmers and agri‑businesses aiming to reduce operational costs, commercial and industrial facilities pursuing sustainability goals, and municipal entities. The company cites residential rooftop arrays, large‑scale commercial installations, and agricultural ground‑mount systems as typical projects.

Wilderness Trace Solar emphasizes transparency and trustworthiness, backing every installation with a 5‑year workmanship warranty and manufacturer warranties on all components. Free estimates, OSHA 10‑certified safety practices, NABCEP‑certified installers, and membership in the Kentucky Solar Energy Industries Association (KYSEIA) are highlighted as differentiators. The team also assists clients with federal Investment Tax Credit (ITC) claims and Solar Renewable Energy Certificate (SREC) registration.

Manufacturer warranties on all parts and equipment

name: Wilson Auto Parts
old_description: For over four decades, Wilson Auto Parts has stood as a pillar of reliability in the wholesale automotive parts industry of northern New Jersey. Our dedication is to streamline your work, not add to it.
about:
Wilson Auto Parts operates from its headquarters in Plainfield, New Jersey, with a network of eleven branches spanning northern New Jersey cities including Newark, Paterson, Jersey City, and Hackensack. The company has served the region for over four decades, though a precise founding year is not publicly stated. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in available materials.

The business functions as a wholesale automotive parts distributor, maintaining relationships with manufacturers to supply a broad range of components and supplies. Its model consolidates procurement: a single call connects service stations, repair shops, and garages to the full catalog across all locations, streamlining ordering and billing. The company emphasizes its team of account managers and customer service specialists who handle fulfillment and customer-specific needs.

Primary customers are independent service stations, auto repair shops, and garages throughout northern New Jersey. The distributor positions itself as a one-stop source for the parts those businesses require daily, leveraging its multi-site inventory to reduce the hassle of multiple deliveries.

Wilson Auto Parts was built to simplify the supply chain for automotive service providers, reducing administrative burden through consolidated ordering and billing while offering competitive pricing through manufacturer relationships.

name: Winar Connection
old_description: Winar has been in the wire and cable industry since 1982. Since then we have focused on developing and perfecting our processes for large cable, wire harness & leads, and so much more!
about:
Winar Connection, a family-run business founded in 1982, operates from its headquarters in Spartanburg, South Carolina, with additional facilities in Richfield, Ohio. The company describes itself as American-made and American-owned, built on decades of people and process experience combined with investment in state-of-the-art equipment.

The company manufactures custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and wire leads, offering precision cutting, stripping, crimping, custom labeling, ultrasonic welding, and braiding. Its capabilities include vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and stocking programs. Production runs on equipment such as a Schleuniger Crimp Center 64, multiple fully automatic crimping machines, a braiding machine, and an ultrasonic welder across three locations. The workforce averages 20 years of tenure, representing over 100 years of combined applied knowledge.

Winar serves industries including motive power, battery charging, electrical power grid, load banks, and data centers. Its customers range from purchasing agents and engineers to vendor partners who access the company’s deep customer base.

The company emphasizes continuous improvement, agile solutions, and responsive leadership as differentiators. It highlights its certifications—UL, IPC, ISO 9001:2015, and WHMA—and its commitment to employees, customers, and vendors as the foundation of its “WIN/WIN” approach.

name: Wire Machine Systems
old_description: Wire Machine Systems (WMS) was founded in 1987 in Fort Wayne, IN. Since its start, WMS has become a premier source of equipment and services to the wire, cable, bar, and tube industries, offering a “one-stop shop” solution to meet all of your needs. Wire Machine Systems’ facility is centrally located to operate on a national and international level as a trusted supplier of machinery, equipment, and spare parts.
about:
Wire Machine Systems was founded in 1987 in Fort Wayne, Indiana. The company entered the market as a supplier of equipment and services to the wire, cable, bar, and tube industries, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for machinery, spare parts, and technical support.

The firm provides state-of-the-art manufacturing equipment — including drawbenches, roll pointers, shot blasting systems, buncher bows, wire straighteners, and spring coiling machines — along with spare parts for European and Asian machinery. A centralized warehouse in Fort Wayne stocks replacement components for a wide range of equipment, allowing the company to ship parts quickly even for machines it did not originally supply. Technical support and application engineering round out the service offering.

Wire Machine Systems serves manufacturers in the wire, cable, bar, and tube sectors, as well as spring producers in automotive, appliance, and industrial markets. Its equipment handles ferrous and non-ferrous materials, and the spare-parts program supports customers across any industry that runs wire, rod, bar, or tube processing lines.

The company emphasizes its 50-plus years of combined industry experience, a one-stop-shop model that bundles equipment sales, spare parts, and dedicated support, and a commitment to rapid response and fair pricing. The Fort Wayne location is described as centrally situated for national and international distribution.

name: Wire Up Electric
old_description: At Wire Up Electric, we provide reliable, professional electrical services for homeowners and businesses throughout Wayne, NJ and North Jersey. about:
Based in Wayne, New Jersey, Wire Up Electric provides electrical installation, maintenance, and emergency services to residential and commercial customers throughout Northern New Jersey. The company operates as a licensed electrical contractor handling projects ranging from panel upgrades and EV charger installations to whole-home rewiring and generator hookups.

The firm’s service portfolio spans both residential and commercial work. On the residential side, it performs service upgrades, troubleshooting, LED lighting retrofits, standby and portable generator installations, pool and hot tub wiring, heated floor circuits, and home automation including thermostat, lighting control, and structured wiring for data and Wi‑Fi. Commercial offerings include LED lighting upgrades, office fit‑outs, data and cable installation, service and maintenance contracts, and emergency repair. The company also installs audio‑video systems such as TV mounting, surround sound, home theater, security cameras, and equipment racks.

Wire Up Electric serves homeowners, property managers, and business owners across Northern New Jersey. Typical clients include single‑family households needing EV charger or generator installations, offices requiring lighting retrofits or structured cabling, and retail or light‑industrial spaces needing service upgrades or ongoing maintenance contracts.

The company emphasizes punctual arrival, clear communication, and respect for the customer’s property as its primary differentiators, along with a commitment to code‑compliant, safe workmanship on every job.
